description: Información de trafico de las Zonas Wi-Fi del municipio de San José de Cúcuta is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. Numero de sesiones y usuarios conectados en las zonas Wi-Fi en el año 2021-2022, cada usuario se puede conectar de forma gratuita durante 30 minutos continuos con opción de re-conexión si la capacidad de usuarios de la zona lo permite. Coverage: Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. Its tags are información de trafico, numero de usuarios conectados, servicios tic, trafico zonas wi-fi, trafico. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2022-10-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
